recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: 93% ground turkey browned with onion, bell pepper, black beans, and salsa. Serve with corn tortillas, avocado, and lime.
steps: Dice the onion and bell pepper. Drain and rinse the beans. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet at the end.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high with a little oil. Add the turkey, onion, and pepper. Break up the turkey and cook 8-10 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt, the beans, and salsa. Simmer 3-4 minutes until hot and slightly thickened.
Serve in tortillas topped with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan chicken bites
recipes.summary: Bite-size chicken thighs seared in butter with garlic and tossed in Parmesan. Serve with whole-wheat pasta and steamed broccoli.
steps: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper. Start the pasta in salted water. Cut broccoli into florets.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the chicken in batches until golden and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining butter and minced garlic to the skillet. Cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Return chicken, toss, then remove from heat and stir in grated Parmesan.
Steam or microwave the broccoli 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp. Drain pasta and toss with a little oil. Plate chicken over pasta with broccoli and parsley.

sources.label: The Kitchn Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bites

recipes.title: Soy-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: Her plate: EZ-peel shrimp stir-fried with broccoli, bell pepper, soy, and ginger over jasmine rice. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)

steps: Pat the shrimp dry. Cut the broccoli into florets and the pepper into strips. Mince the garlic and ginger. Start the rice pouch.
Heat a large skillet over high heat with a little oil. Cook the broccoli and pepper 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender. Push to the side.
Add the garlic and ginger for 20 seconds. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook 1-2 minutes per side until just opaque and pink.
Splash with soy sauce, toss everything together, and scatter the sliced green onions. Serve over rice.

sources.label: Simply Recipes Easy Shrimp Stir Fry

recipes.title: Sheet-pan salmon with potatoes and green beans
recipes.summary: Her plate: Atlantic salmon roasted with baby potatoes, green beans, garlic, and lemon. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Halve the baby potatoes. Toss potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim the green beans. Toss beans with a little oil, smashed garlic, salt, and pepper.
Push potatoes to one side. Add green beans and place salmon in the center. Season salmon with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of oil. Roast 12-14 minutes until salmon flakes and veggies are tender.
Squeeze lemon over the plates before serving.

sources.label: Budget Bytes One Pan Salmon Dinner
